validation_failed.title: Please check your input
validation_failed.message: The server did not accept some of the values. Correct the fields marked below (the server message names the problem) and try again.
validation_failed.messageNoFields: The server did not accept the values. The server message names the problem: correct it and try again.

bad_request.title: Request not understood
bad_request.message: The server could not read the request, for example because a value had the wrong format. Reload the page and try again; if it keeps happening, report it with the request ID.

unauthenticated.title: Please sign in
unauthenticated.message: You are not signed in, or your session has ended (it expires after a period of inactivity, at sign-out, or when it is revoked). Sign in again to continue where you left off.

forbidden.title: Not permitted
forbidden.message: Your roles do not allow this action here, or the product is archived or the tenant suspended. Ask an owner or administrator of this product or tenant for access.

reauthentication_required.title: Please sign in again
reauthentication_required.message: For your security this action is only allowed shortly after signing in. Sign in again, then repeat the action.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.message: This item does not exist, was deleted, or you have no access to it (Axentra does not reveal items you cannot see). Check the address or ask for access.

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.message: This clashes with existing data or the item's current state, for example a name or key that is already taken. Read the server message, then change the value or the item's state and try again.

precondition_failed.title: Changed in the meantime
precondition_failed.message: Someone else saved a change to this item after you opened it, so your change was not applied. Reload the item and make your change again.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.message: The server received too many requests (or failed sign-in attempts) in a short time. Wait about a minute and try again.

quota_exceeded.title: Quota exceeded
quota_exceeded.message: A quota or plan limit of this tenant is used up, so the server refused the action. Free up space or usage, or ask someone with access to raise the quota or change the plan.

backdating_not_permitted.title: Before the billing period
backdating_not_permitted.message: This tenant's current billing period started on {{periodStart, datetime(dateStyle: medium; timeStyle: short)}}. Usage that happened earlier can only be recorded with usage:manage for the whole product. Record it with a later time, or ask a product administrator.

mode_not_supported.title: Not available in this mode
mode_not_supported.message: The server's configuration does not allow this action here, for example creating products in single-product mode, changing a subscription that Stripe manages (change it in Stripe), or opening the test mailbox when the server sends real email. The server message names the reason; only an operator can change the configuration.

module_disabled.title: Module not enabled
module_disabled.message: The server module needed for this action is switched off. An operator can enable it in the Axentra server configuration.

payment_provider_not_configured.title: Payment provider not configured
payment_provider_not_configured.message: This billing action needs a payment provider, but the server has none configured. An operator has to set up the payment provider in the server configuration.

internal.title: Server error
internal.message: The server or a service behind it failed while handling the request; your change may not have been saved. Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, report it to your operator with the request ID.

network_error.title: Server not reachable
network_error.message: Studio got no answer from the Axentra server. Check your network connection; if it works, the server may be down or restarting. Try again in a moment.

unknown.title: Unexpected error
unknown.message: The request failed for a reason Studio does not recognize. Try again; if it keeps happening, report it with the request ID and the server message.

payload_too_large.title: Too large
payload_too_large.message: The request or file is larger than the server accepts. Use a smaller file or less data, or ask an operator about the size limit.

unsupported_media_type.title: Type not accepted
unsupported_media_type.message: The server does not accept this type of content, for example a blocked file type such as an executable, HTML or SVG file. Use a different file type.

method_not_allowed.title: Action not supported
method_not_allowed.message: The server does not offer this action at this address (HTTP 405). Studio and the server versions probably do not match. Reload the page; if it keeps happening, report it with the request ID.

error.title: Request failed
error.message: The server refused the request with an HTTP error that has no more specific code. Check the server message and the HTTP status under Technical details and try again; if it keeps happening, report it with the request ID.

invalid_signature.title: Invalid signature
invalid_signature.message: The signature of a payment provider webhook did not match. This concerns the server's connection to the payment provider, not Studio; an operator should check the webhook secret.

setup_already_completed.title: Setup is already complete
setup_already_completed.message: A platform administrator already exists on this server, so setup cannot run again. Sign in with an existing account.

email_taken.title: Email address in use
email_taken.message: Another account already uses this email address. Use a different address, or sign in with the existing account.

api_key_creator_lost_access.title: API key refused: its creator lost a permission
api_key_creator_lost_access.message: The API key was refused because the person who created it no longer holds the permission {{permission}}. A key works only as long as its creator still holds the permissions it uses. Give the permission back to that person, or create a new key as someone who holds it and revoke the old one.
api_key_creator_lost_access.messageNoPermission: The API key was refused because the person who created it no longer holds a permission this request needs. A key works only as long as its creator still holds the permissions it uses. Give the permission back to that person, or create a new key as someone who holds it and revoke the old one.
